text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Draw blade!! Right here!! Yaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Drawing the "Holy Sword" at the carefully calculated moment, Durandal made her move, but—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh, so it's here.
Yes, this power is—!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"I transform from 'ore' to 'watashi'.
I shall bring about the turning of fate!"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From the third form to the first!
Taaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Tanino Gimlet! It's Tanino Gimlet!
The demanding rotation straight from the Satsuki Sho
has paid off in magnificent fashion!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Fall, Mile! Plunge into the depths of eternal night!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ghk, as expected of the Demon King of the Sixth Heaven...
My sword technique wasn't bad either.
But—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "To dodge even that carefully aimed strike..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The winner was Tanino Gimlet.
Even so, Durandal's 'Holy Sword' had also
sent the crowd into absolute raptures.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... Durandal!
That had quite the sharp edge.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so the one who trained her was... that rookie Trainer.
Not bad!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
My King's name is <username>.
Please keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Right now, she is merely the king of a small nation. But soon,
she will rule over the entire realm and become
the linchpin of the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It definitely felt a bit exaggerated.
Even so, plenty of people ended up remembering Durandal and me.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh-heh, the purification is complete, and the time has come.
In that case――

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Let us return. As our covenant decrees,
back to the proving grounds of the Classic Triple Crown.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Gimlet-san...
Your sudden surprise attack caught me off guard.
However...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Once an urgent battle ends, it belongs to the past.
May fortune favor your upcoming battles, and please take care of yourself.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Ah, now I have obtained the key.
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
All that remains is to reach it.
The promised peak.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Tanino Gimlet had gained something as well. She returned to her original path once again.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I have returned.
Today's greatest harvest was—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"It made your name even better known.
There could be no greater joy!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I hope that with this... I was able to repay a little bit of the immense debt of gratitude I owe you...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: “This humble Durandal... shall take you to ever greater heights...!”

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: King <username>...!
choice_data_list: Truly chivalrous, that was a wonderful run!
Truly chivalrous, that was a wonderful run!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Ah... ah...
D-Do you really think so...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"—Excuse me, but...
Still..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King, I am honored by your praise.
If it would not be an imposition, well...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Could you repeat that once more, please?
What you just said...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: (Ah... I'm being praised...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(I can't get carried away... I should have learned by now.
I must not. But...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(This... feeling of being fulfilled...
Ah, give me more...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No—my apologies.
I must restrain myself... The Princess told me so as well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Durandal stood formally at attention,
muttering something under her breath."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the NHK Mile Cup came to an end,
and the battle moved on to the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My King. That concludes our defensive campaign—
Where shall we march next?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If you have an estimate in mind, by all means, let me hear it.
choice_data_list: Shall we try a sprint next?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A sprint... That means 1200 meters, right?
Is there a specific aim behind this?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The 1200m sprint and the 1600m mile are
both classified as "short-distance routes."
However, there is a massive difference. That is—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"The difficulty of late-surge tactics."
Because a 1,200m sprint allows runners to sprint at full throttle from the very start...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Running at a consistently fast pace gives the advantage.
Turning it into a battle of late-stretch kicks makes the odds of reaching them too low.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: I see. You wish to hone your skills on a battlefield where your "Holy Sword" holds less sway.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Which means your target race would be the GⅠ Sprinters Stakes held in September, correct?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A 1200m GⅠ featuring Senior Class runners is far too steep a wall.
With Durandal as she is now, even putting up a decent fight is doubtful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems most reasonable to run in lower-grade races for a bit,
and then return to mile races from there. Therefore—
choice_data_list: Let's go with the GⅡ Centaur Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "The Centaur Stakes, is it? As a GII, there would certainly be less of an enclosure than at the Sprinters Stakes."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
—Understood. Let us proceed. Next up after
the battle with the fallen angel is a battle with "restraints."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's test the potential of the "Holy Sword"!
Yeah, let's test the potential of the Holy Sword!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Durandal, ever devoted to the late-race burst. But just how short
of a distance can she handle?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We won't know for sure until we run her.
Let us assess our future path at the Centaur Stakes this autumn, in September.
